newsitem.title: ISRAEL: FedEx to begin own Israel route by June.
newsitem.headline: FedEx to begin own Israel route by June.

text.p: The U.S. courier Federal Express said on Monday it would begin flying cargo to and from Israel on its own planes by June.

David Bronczek, FedEx vice president for Europe, Africa and the Middle East, said during a private visit to Israel the company would make four flights a week. FedEx said it had already received approval from Israel's Airports Authority.
It had previously sent cargo to Israel on commercial airlines, including state-owned Israeli carrier El Al. Bronczek is meeting with El Al officials about future cooperation, FedEx said.
"Until now it wasn't financially worthwhile to use the company's planes. Now, with the growing amount of cargo going in and coming out, it is worthwhile," said a spokesman.
FedEx said in a statement Bronczek would return to Israel in May to work out details of the company's expanded service to Israel.
